description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a Make More Keep More press conference in Concord alongside local elected officials and business owners. They discussed Roy Cooper's shortcomings as governor, including energy prices up 30%, housing costs up 85%, and healthcare premiums up 183%, something Cooper is eager for voters to forget. Whatley also highlighted his commitment to ensure North Carolinians make more and keep more of their own money.

title: Michael Whatley hosts Make More Keep More Press Conference in Concord – Michael Whatley for Senate
